name: CRBR-S safe code
help: Use the printed clue number (1–3), not the order you visited the rooms. Search Garment Factory, Service Passage and Grocery Store with the blacklight. Enter each two-digit value.

name: Zodiac scratch calculator
help: For each room record its zodiac sign and all three scratch counts. A confirmed zero is different from an unread clue. Enter telescope signs from the lowest total to the highest. A failed attempt rerolls clues: reset and collect them again.

name: Alistair symbol notebook
help: Describe the observed glyph beside each colour. Keep the colour labels attached when entering the library lock. This notebook does not infer unseen glyphs.

name: Valve solver
help: Choose the room with the green light and the room containing the cylinder. Follow the returned valve positions; the cylinder room is the endpoint.

name: Bomb order recorder
help: Record the six locations in the order shown by SOPHIA. Defuse in exactly this order. Do not substitute the valve route.

name: Buoy Morse calculator
help: Read the three buoy digits through the shield (Gondola, Recreation Yard, Model Industries). Enter a digit 0–9 or its five Morse pulses. The answer is the sum, encoded digit by digit.

name: Project Skadi codes
help: Record the four-digit code against its picture. The required input order is already shown below; collection order does not matter.

name: Rushmore clock clues
help: Enter five TV clues as a letter A–F followed by HHMM, for example A0115. Set those clocks, then read the remaining clock yourself. Its time is not calculated from these clues.

name: RAI K-84 dartboard
help: Select the three sectors observed on the computer, reading clockwise from the top sector (20). Shoot the resulting numbers on the dartboard, then the bullseye.

name: Mimic memory tracker
help: Mark a name only after the Memory Transference Station accepts that memory. An ordinary Mimic capture does not count.

name: Train glyph notebook
help: Record the three glyphs seen from the train. Describe their shape and keep each observation separate; use your collected set at the sword wall.

name: Finale player assignments
help: The final tram/keeper step needs four players in an unmodded match. Assign three station players and one junction player before starting.

name: Void Bow name and glyph notebook
help: Record the three spoken names in order. Interact with the matching knight for each name, then describe the glyph it reveals. Use those observed glyphs in the spoken order.

name: Terminal symbol boards
help: Record which symbol is displayed in each position. Use the board for the current station to match the requested symbol. Reset between new displays.

name: Bow upgrade tracker
help: Track each branch independently. Ranked quest requirements depend on player count; unranked requires all four. Follow the guide for the upgrade actions.

name: Plant growth log
help: Track one plant across three growth rounds. Blue favours rewards, green a zombie holder, purple a killer plant; mixed watering can produce fruit. KT-4 treatment changes possible rewards. Outcomes are not guaranteed. Reset for another plant.

name: Equipment and cog tracker
help: Confirm completed equipment and elevator cogs. The anti-aircraft shell comes from plant rewards; failed attempts can require another growth cycle.

name: Kronorium rune order
help: Describe the four runes in the order shown by the Kronorium, then use that order at the floating symbols. Reset for a new attempt.

name: Quest collection tracker
help: Keep each collection separate. Only one egg is visible on the map at a time; the player who collected an egg supplies its souls.

name: Setup and secrets
help: Teleporter links, Fly Trap and the hidden perk are separate objectives. Use a Pack-a-Punched weapon to begin Fly Trap.

name: Samantha secret tracker
help: This is the Zombies Chronicles version. There is no normal power or Pack-a-Punch quest on this map.

name: Spawn-side setup reference
help: Choose your starting side. Both routes meet at power; teammates can initially be separated.

name: Hut perk notebook
help: Record the perk found at each hut. Undiscovered huts stay unknown.

name: Samantha knock recorder
help: Count the knocks in each of the three groups. Enter the observed counts and use them when repeating the sequence. This is a manual recorder, not audio recognition.

name: LUNA route and assignments
help: Four players are required. Ride Spawn → Stamin-Up, Stamin-Up → Spawn, Spawn → Speed Cola, Speed Cola → Stamin-Up. A teammate calls the lander at each destination.

name: Matching tile notebook
help: Number tiles consistently on each side. Describe revealed symbols using the same label for matching glyphs. Only matches you have observed are shown.

name: Samantha Says sequence
help: First record the colour at each screen position. Then record the flashing colours in order. The result gives the positions to press. Clear the sequence for each new attempt.

name: Staff upgrade tracker
help: Each staff needs its record, three parts and elemental crystal before building. Complete its elemental puzzle, align the excavation rings, shoot the orb and charge the staff in the Crazy Place.

name: Ice staff symbol decoder
help: Select the dot pattern currently on the tablet. Shoot the matching ceiling glyph shown below, then record the next tablet. A hollow circle is zero, a single dot is one and a vertical pair is two; read groups left to right.

fields.label: Tablet pattern
options: Two stacked dots · two stacked dots

name: Fire staff torch decoder
help: Select the four glowing church patterns. Light the corresponding basement torches promptly with the fire staff. Torch 4 is marked by blood instead of a chalk numeral.

name: Ra enemy order
help: Record the enemies represented by the four obelisk symbols, in order. Kill the required special enemies in that order; use the guide’s symbol chart to identify them. Clear the sequence for the next display.

name: Danu preparation tracker
help: Track full completed rounds, not merely the round number when you placed an item. Check the item visually before confirming readiness.

name: Elemental clock notebook
help: Record the four changed clocks by their associated element. Match the minute controls at the bridge and hour controls at Engine Room/Poop Deck using the guide diagrams. Outputs are target times, not guessed rotation counts.

name: Celestial order recorder
help: Record the celestial sequence shown in your match. Match each symbol to its location using the guide. The Sun is handled at the final stage.

name: Power House visual companion
help: Record the Simon sequence, select the three steady-light symbols, then record each replacement from the Model Industries monitors. No fixed translation is assumed.

name: Kronorium & five-trial tracker
help: Read a fresh book code for each assignment. Check a trial only after collecting its red stone. Changing the code does not clear completed trials.

name: Free Blundergat skull tracker
help: Use the shield to see each skull and the Retriever to collect it. When all five are collected, check the Warden’s Office desk.

fields.label: West Grounds — outside Model Industries stairs

name: Hand progression
help: Track Fallen, Redeemed and Exalted stages separately. Exalted upgrades are optional unless the selected objective specifically requires them.

name: Theater hand assignments
help: Assign each player’s hand before entering the theater. Respond to the matching hand cue during the performance; this helper does not automate live timing.

name: Rushmore codes and quest notes
help: Search bonus effects and keep your match-specific quest codes below. Enter only a code whose effect you intend to use; optional bonus codes and quest codes have different conditions.

fields.label: Bonus effect
options: Easy · 3279 · Slow zombies for five minutes.
Noob · 6662 · Slow zombies for five minutes.
Door · 3667 · One random unopened door becomes free.
Quiz · 1841 · Quiz dialogue; no answer input.
Guns · 4867 · All players change weapons every ten seconds for five minutes.
Shed · 7433 · Open the Yellow House backyard shed.
Fall · 3255 · Looking at zombies knocks them over.
Grav · 4728 · Kills float upward for 25 minutes.

name: Offering and Seal riddle lookup
help: Search for words from the clue, then choose the exact offering or Seal riddle. Search does not automatically choose a result.

name: Challenge and charge tracker
help: Keep the quest’s required challenge rewards separate from completing every optional challenge for a weapon reward.

name: D.I.E. variant tracker
help: The base weapon can come from its free quest, trials or the box. Crafting shortcuts do not replace Aetherscope and diary prerequisites for the main quest.

name: Neutralizer preparation
help: Activate Fuel Processing with the players in your match, survive its lockdown and collect the tank. For each growth, shoot orbiting orbs, break it with Chrysalax and feed the shard to an Abomination before collecting the catalyzed shard.

name: Launch order notebook
help: The consoles are A, B and D. Record confirmed accepted positions, or a console rejected at a particular position. Only record a later rejection after the earlier positions were accepted in that attempt.

name: Quest region reference
help: Choose the quest and your current region. Region availability differs by objective; check the linked location guide before warping.
